method.pricing: Price, 24h change, market cap, and FDV are read only from each canonical mint’s established Solana/WSOL pair of record.
method.liquidity: Liquidity and 24h volume are read from the same established Solana/WSOL pair of record. Duplicate pair records are counted once.
method.valuation: Market cap is recorded only when DexScreener reports marketCap. FDV is stored separately and is never used as a market-cap substitute.
method.limitations: DexScreener is an independent index. A snapshot can be delayed, incomplete, or wrong, and does not represent a recommendation.
